design_timing: Fixed after inspecting validation results from notebooks 09-12 and before scoring the reserved final period. Not independent preregistration, not a pristine blind test.

target.geography: The same 31 rental-source metropolitan LGAs and original area labels as notebooks 09-12

primary_comparison.direction: Negative pooled difference favours the candidate. Positive favours last_observation. Numeric differences alone imply neither practical importance nor statistical significance.
primary_comparison.tie_policy: Describe as numerically tied within tolerance; retain last_observation as the simpler reference, not a deployment decision.

methods.name: seasonal_naive
methods.rule: forecast(t) = rent(t-4), same area/property; origin is still t-1

rolling_evaluation.origin_rule: target t minus one calendar quarter
rolling_evaluation.history_access: Only same-area/property observations with quarters <= t-1; no cross-area pooling. Construct the prediction before attaching target t actuals for scoring.
rolling_evaluation.refit_policy: Refit the scaler and trained model at every area/origin on all earlier eligible supervised targets. No fitted coefficients are frozen across origins.
rolling_evaluation.earlier_final_outcomes: An earlier final-period outcome may enter history only for later origins under this fixed one-step protocol. Final-period errors must not alter features, alpha, damping, model choice or window.
rolling_evaluation.warm_up: Exactly the first four source quarters cannot form complete historical lag vectors. No further target deletion or filling.
rolling_evaluation.calendar_encoding: Known target Q2/Q3/Q4 indicators; Q1 reference; standardize all model inputs within each training fold.

metrics.weighting: Every one of the 248 LGA-quarter targets has equal weight; no rental-count, population or LGA-size weights.
metrics.pooled_rmse: sqrt(mean(all individual squared errors)); not the mean of LGA RMSEs.
metrics.relative_mae_improvement_percent: 100 * (MAE_last - MAE_candidate) / MAE_last; undefined when MAE_last is zero.
metrics.paired_reporting: Report both forecast-level error differences and per-LGA/per-quarter differences. Keep every target.
metrics.inference: Descriptive only. No p-values, iid confidence intervals, statistical-significance claims, prediction intervals or automatic deployment rule. Targets share quarters and histories and are not asserted independent.

safeguards.retain_finite_negative_predictions: Retain and flag if any occur; no after-the-fact clipping. Non-finite predictions or missing coverage stop the run.
safeguards.missing_or_duplicate_targets: Fail, investigate and document; never silently omit records to improve results.
safeguards.after_results: Do not retune on these outcomes and present a repeat as a fresh final test. A later redesign requires new independent evidence.
safeguards.implementation_bug: Preserve the original attempt, identify the bug, document any outcome exposure and the correction, and rerun the unchanged intended specification. Do not erase an unfavourable result or claim a rerun is unseen evidence.

required_final_evidence: 248 unique area/quarter predictions per method; 992 total
Training range and scaler evidence for every trained fit
Independent mathematical checks of trained predictions
Target-actual mutation/removal self-checks on fictional data
Identical target coverage and paired-loss reconciliation
Prior validation evidence verified, not silently regenerated or overwritten
CSV save/read-back and input/release fingerprint checks
Python, pandas, numpy and scikit-learn versions recorded
Protocol fingerprint, pre-scoring lock commit and execution commit recorded separately
limitations: Single 2025Q3 workbook vintage; historical publication lags and revisions not reconstructed. Period-based retrospective evaluation, not a real-time backtest.
Final outcomes appeared in prior descriptive EDA and the explorer. Reserved from modelling evaluation, not a pristine blind test.
Candidate designed after inspecting validation errors; the validation advantage is development evidence.
Published nominal medians cover changing lettings, not a fixed property or inflation-adjusted series.
Eight final quarters are a limited later-period check, not proof of performance at all future dates.

output_policy.earlier_evidence: Do not overwrite notebooks 09-12, their configs, reports or outputs.
output_policy.comparison_policy: Keep final-period metrics separate from validation metrics; do not blend them to manufacture a better headline.
output_policy.publication: Research only. No current-rent forecast, online-app change, release-data edit, registry change, model pickle or automatic promotion.

commit_gate.before_scoring: Commit these three protocol files and push the research branch; run the verifier with --require-committed. The later scoring notebook must record that pre-scoring commit and protocol digest.
commit_gate.what_the_verifier_proves: Configuration identity, branch and local Git recording only; not that nobody has inspected outcomes, not remote push success, not correctness of future forecast code.
